nodes.label: Anatomy of Trading Loss - 4 Common Mistakes
nodes.description: Educational chart showing anatomy of a losing trade on H1 candles (price chart ~1.085-1.110), annotating 4 typical mistakes: FOMO entry without clear signal, stop too close (20 pips), moving stop further to give trade a chance, closing manually at peak pain without waiting for stop

nodes.label: Mistake 1: FOMO Entry Without Clear Signal
nodes.description: First annotated mistake on chart: entering a trade without a clear signal due to FOMO (Fear Of Missing Out), marked at candle ~17

nodes.label: Mistake 2: Stop Loss Too Close (20 pips)
nodes.description: Second annotated mistake: placing stop loss too close, only 20 pips away, at an emotional level — marked at candle ~35

nodes.label: Mistake 3: Moving Stop Further To Give Trade a Chance
nodes.description: Third annotated mistake: moving the stop loss further away to avoid being stopped out, marked at candle ~52

nodes.label: Mistake 4: Closing Manually at Peak Pain Without Waiting for Stop
nodes.description: Fourth annotated mistake: closing the trade manually at the worst emotional moment (peak pain) instead of waiting for stop loss to trigger, marked at candle ~68

nodes.label: Trading Psychology - Behavioral Errors
nodes.description: Conceptual node representing trading psychology themes shown in image: FOMO, emotional stop management, panic closing

nodes.label: Risk Management - Stop Loss Discipline
nodes.description: Conceptual node representing risk management lessons: proper stop placement, not moving stops, letting stops execute
